![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

These two database calls are executed sequentially, which increases the page load time due to multiple round-trips. Since `User_Roles` and `Profiles` are related, you can fetch both in a single query using a join. This is more efficient and simplifies the data fetching logic.

```suggestion
  // Fetch the user's profile and role in a single query to reduce latency
  const { data: profileData } = await supabase
    .from('Profiles')
    .select('display_name, email, User_Roles(role)')
    .eq('id', user.id)
    .single()

  const role = (profileData as any)?.User_Roles?.role || 'UNKNOWN'
```
